subject: general
question: In which year was India's first National Air Sports Policy (NASP) released by the Ministry of Civil Aviation?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2022**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Taking another step in the direction of making India one of the top air sports nations by 2030, the Union Ministry of Civil Aviation announced the country’s first 'National Air Sports Policy' in June 2022.
 
• The policy will cover air sports such as aerobatics, aeromodelling, model rocketry, amateur-built and experimental aircraft, ballooning, drones, gliding, and powered gliding, hang-gliding and powered hang-gliding, parachuting (including skydiving, Base jumping, and wingsuit flying), paragliding and paramotoring (including powered parachute trikes), powered aircraft and rotorcraft.
 
• The Air Sports Federation of India (ASFI) will be the apex governing body for this initiative. 
 
• This federation will be chaired by Civil Aviation Ministry Secretary Rajiv Bansal.
 
• The ASFI is an autonomous body and will present India at the Fédération Aéronautique Internationale (FAI) and other global platforms related to air sports.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• World Air Sports Federation.

 
 
• The World Air Sports Federation (FAI)** is responsible for establishing rules and regulations for air sports and aeronautical records**.
 
• The FAI also promotes safety, proficiency, and skill in aeronautics.
 
• The FAI **awards awards to those who work on restoring old aircraft.**
 
• **Founded on 14 October 1905.**
 
• Headquarters are located in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• President is David Monks.
